principles.title: Nature first

testimonials.quote: The villa feels like stepping into a dream. The silence, the light, the way the architecture honors the land — everything whispers rather than shouts. We didn't want to leave.
testimonials.name: Amelia R.

testimonials.quote: Exactly what a mountain retreat should feel like — no clutter, no noise, just space to breathe.
testimonials.name: Daniel & Sasha

testimonials.quote: We came for the views and stayed for the quiet. A rare kind of stillness.
testimonials.name: Putri W.

location.title: Rooted in Bandung
location.paragraph1: The surrounding hills hold centuries of tradition. Terraced farms create rhythm across the slopes. Morning mist rises from the valleys, and with it comes a clarity that's rare.
location.paragraph2: Twenty minutes from central Bandung — close enough for convenience, far enough for true quiet.
